style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and infographics, flat misty grey-blue #E8EEF0 panels for cover and CTA, real outdoor locations for scenes
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color #5E969E, rounded pill labels
style.lightingSystem: soft directional key light from the left, neutral-cool studio light with soft contact shadows for product shots; natural daylight around 5500K for scenes
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent rugged outdoor travel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, misty grey-blue panel #E8EEF0, charcoal text #33383D, one dusty teal accent #5E969E, and one warm leather-brown accent #A9683C reserved for hardware and trim details in the photography; neutral-cool lighting with a soft directional key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif type, headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt; consistent rounded pill info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; crisp product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale with balanced composition margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the backpack across the set; full silhouette visible when not in macro; warm leather-brown #A9683C appears only as small hardware and trim accents inside the photography
style.surfaceSystem: dark matte wood tabletop #3B3230 for tabletop shots, compacted gravel and rock for trail scenes
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt, all in charcoal #33383D
